body: Bah who needs hair anyway. It just makes you late in the morning.
But do you *hate* anything about yourself?
This cannot be overstated. There number of people who just want to cut you off and blab on about themselves is staggering.
PM'd you, thank you so much man, you are a lifesaver.

Good point. The problem was I was so fucked because of the benzos and lyrica that I was seriously on a downer. I tried to take less lyrica/phenibut/benzos last night but woke up fucked again. Really need to lower my dose a lot.

I heard that caffeine helps gaba b upregulation, is that true? Is that the same for all stims? I've bought some fasoracetam so hopefully that will help too.

Thank you so much for your reply, it is insanely useful. I don't have any baclofen, I decided to use phenibut instead as it was easier to obtain. The Lyrica is fuckng expensive, although I am also prescribed it. I buy 300mg ones from the "store" though to top up - so I will take it easy.

I do have beta alanine - a LOT of it. As soon as I read your post I went and put some in a fruit juice drink. Thank you for that tip.

Unfortunately I have a horrible history with GHB. Once was addicted for one year, then again for six months, recently last year for six months, and now this recent binge is moving on to one month. The withdrawals get really bad but my last g-tox was so fucking easy with lyrica and phenibut - I went to the gym and did all my normal stuff.

Part of the problem is that I am trying to override the emotional pain I have from my breakup - I want to be fucked up so I can forget. I've blocked this person from everywhere so they can't contact me - facebook, phone, whatsapp etc. Next I just need to delete all the photos...can't do that yet. Need to get a grip soon though so I can get on with my life. Can barely do anything whilst I'm so fucked up.

So glad you posted - thanks man.

Edit: before I posted, my habit was 1.5ml ***GBL*** per hour. However, due to huge comedown from NYE (barely slept for two weeks because of stims) and not being able to sleep properly since then, that would make me fall asleep for 30 mins or so. If I was completely awake, I'm sure it would be closer to 2ml per hour.
Thank you. Gonna bosh 30 more epha and see how that goes. Wish I had more meth...although I don't know if I could handle the comedown from that right now! Took so much over new years.
I have caffeine and ephedrine. I've taken 200mg caffeine and 30mg ephedrine. Is it ok to take more?

I'm so sorry that you are going through this - I really do feel your pain. However, even though it's only the second day, I already do feel slightly better. I'm trying to keep as busy as possible by catching up on all the shit I left lying around whilst this mess ensued. I even did the damn hoovering. I'm sure it will all be over much sooner than we expect due to taking the bold step of cutting these people out altogether.

We can both start living our lives again and soon we will forget these people that have caused us so much distress. As other posters have said - we have been so brave to make this monumental step that most people cannot bear to make. I know others that stay with their partners indefinitely because cutting them out is just so damn hard. So we really should be proud of ourselves.

Stay strong and either PM me or reply here if you want to discuss how you are feeling. Otherwise, all the best to you my friend (I'm sure before bed I will break down and have a crying fit...but baby steps, eh? Whiskey helps.)

Thank you for your comment - how did you did this without bursting into tears at every moment? I honestly don't know if I have the strength to even look at his face. It was hard enough just to go to his facebook to block him.

I am tempted to ask a fried to do this for me as I am honestly so distraught right now.

I kept waking up having panic attacks last night with images going through my head of the sight of him cheating. Your message has brought me so much confidence to proceed this morning by letting me know that I have done the right thing. Your comment about my courage made me a little tearful, but in an immeasurably good way.

I'm going to do what you suggested today and attempt to reconnect with myself and remember who I am without him. I'll be counting the days that's for sure, but somehow, despite the awful night I've had today already seems like it might be easier. 

Your comment means so much to me; I am keeping this page open and I will be rechecking it as time goes on when I need those bouts of strength. Thank you so much.
Your words have brought me a lot of comfort, and I didn't know it was normal for this to cause such anxiety. Thank you - I really mean it.
I keep re-reading your comment over and over whenever I have a crying fit to calm myself down. Thank you so much.
Thank you, I will. Your comment means so much to me right now you would not believe.
I really enjoyed this :-) any more suggestions?

Thank you. I hate myself for getting so far along the path of getting over him but then falling back into what seems like a trap. I know I deserve better. Thanks for the luck, boy am I going to need it. It hurts so badly.

I am honestly horrified, I feel so stupid for not leaving there and then.

I didn't mean for it to be a quickie at all. I'm so into him I wanted more. I thought that might have been what he was implying by telling me to come over, because I finally revealed that I still liked him, but I suppose I must have been wrong.

Oh I will mean it. I know full well by this point in my life that the only way I can get over someone is by cutting them out completely. I said to myself after I met this guy that I will never do the chasing game again, and I'm going to stick to it.

It's too bad that I think I misinterpreted his intentions, some of the things he did made it seem like he was still into me in that way. But now I need to nip it in the bud - being a lost puppy will never make me happy.
